text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- The government is moving to protect the rice export trade by setting up a national fund to support exporters and the planning of long-term investment to boost the quality of exports.
-- The output of Vietnam's agro-forestry industry in the first six months of 1997 was 2.121 trillion dong ($182 million), up 8.7 percent from the same period last year.
-- Tax revenues were lower than expected in the first half of this year as tax bureau encountered difficulties in collecting real estate-related taxes and fees.
-- The German Federal Bureau of Investigation will provide technical equipment for task forces in charge of fighting organized drug traffickers and criminals.
-- Hanoi celebrated the 85th anniversary of the birthday of former Communist Party chief Nguyen Van Cu on Tuesday.
-- Vietnam has established a national committee on agricultural product security to control the implementation of national foodstuff policy and trade.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet issued a decision on Tuesday on the building of a national strategy for developing the country's education till the year 2020.
-- Ho Chi Minh City's People's Council approved a resolution on Tuesday to promote the development of city's socio-economy in the second half of 1997.
